parties: True North Fund V LLP; Home First Finance Company India Limited
headline: True North Fund V LLP files SEBI Takeover Regulation Disclosure for Home First Finance
sum: True North Fund V LLP has filed a substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations Regulation 31(4), signalling a significant shareholding development in Home First Finance Company India Limited, a non-bank housing finance company.
implication: A Regulation 31(4) disclosure indicates the acquirer has crossed a disclosure threshold (likely 5% or greater shareholding); partners should monitor for mandatory offer obligations under Regulation 3 or exemptions claimed, and review the disclosure for any regulatory conditions or funding sources.
detail: True North Fund V LLP, a private equity fund, has submitted a formal disclosure to NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This disclosure is triggered when a person or entity crosses prescribed thresholds of equity shareholding or voting rights in a listed company. Home First Finance Company India Limited is a non-bank housing finance company listed on NSE and BSE. The filing does not yet confirm a full mandatory open offer, but indicates the requisite triggering event under takeover law.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 – Regulation 31(4)
framework.note: Disclosure of acquisition of shares/voting rights by any person; triggers at 5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, 25%, 30%, 40%, 50%, 60%, 70%, 80% and 90% thresholds.
Mandatory open offer requirement when acquisition of 25% or more of voting capital; exemptions exist for certain fund structures and acquisitions.
Exemptions from mandatory offer; includes acquisition by persons or entities that may qualify under specific carve-outs (e.g., acquisition of shares in open market, certain institutional investors).

framework.ref: Reserve Bank of India – Non-Banking Financial Companies (Housing Finance) Regulations, 2010
framework.note: RBI regulatory framework for housing finance companies; Home First requires RBI license and compliance with capital adequacy, lending norms and governance standards.
Change of control disclosure and reporting by the listed company; board meetings and shareholder notification requirements.

framework.ref: Listing Regulations (SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015)
framework.note: Continuous disclosure obligations; material information reporting and related-party transaction rules if applicable post-acquisition.
Tax exemption for transfer of shares in a scheme of amalgamation or reconstruction; relevant if post-acquisition restructuring planned.
Foreign investment in Indian housing finance company regulated if True North Fund V has non-resident limited partner(s); sectoral cap and reporting thresholds apply.

conditions: Crossing of SEBI takeover regulation disclosure threshold (likely 5% or higher)
approvals: RBI approval if acquiring entity is a regulated financial institution or shareholding trigger regulatory reporting
structure.novel: Regulation 31(4) disclosure does not yet confirm the size of stake or whether a mandatory open offer will be triggered; market awaits further disclosures or announcement.

triggers.law: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011
triggers.note: Disclosure milestone at threshold crossing; potential mandatory open offer if 25%+ of voting capital acquired and no exemption claimed.

triggers.law: RBI (Non-Banking Financial Companies Housing Finance) Regulations, 2010
triggers.note: Material change in control may trigger RBI regulatory approval and enhanced capital/governance scrutiny.
If True North Fund V or its investors are non-residents, sectoral caps and prior approval requirements may apply.
